Vendored third-party libraries.

- `force-graph.min.js` — force-graph v1.51.4 (https://github.com/vasturiano/force-graph, MIT).
  Canvas force-directed rendering for the Obsidian-style knowledge-graph explorer
  popup (static/js/panels/graph_explorer.js). The compact in-panel Studio graph
  is a hand-rolled SVG in static/js/panels/studio.js and needs no library.
